subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Google: The Algorithm That Won
description: A quick win: understand Google: The Algorithm That Won.

hook.text: In 1998, two Stanford PhD students ranked web pages by counting who linked to them.

buildup.text: PageRank treated links as votes. More links from important pages meant higher rankings.

discovery.text: Google's results were dramatically better than Yahoo, AltaVista, or any other search engine.

twist.text: Google's home page was almost empty — just a logo and a search box. That simplicity was radical.

climax.text: Google became a verb. 'Just Google it' replaced 'look it up' in everyday language.

punchline.text: A college project became the world's front door.
